prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image: Image 1 is the approved base layout for the Frank Ad Radar "Signal Desk" desktop operator screen.
Primary request: Preserve the entire 1440x900-style composition, app-shell proportions, three-pane layout, pipeline ribbon, typography, icons, spacing, property-photo thumbnails, and operator density. Change only the following factual-copy and color violations.

1. Red accent cleanup: remove every red or pink accent except the red slash inside the Frank mark and the single tiny selected-dot beside "Signal Desk" in the left rail. Convert the red/pink attention, asset-mismatch, and quarantine borders to neutral #ECECEC hairlines with #111111 text and black outline icons. Attention and quarantine must remain unmistakable through their words and outline symbols, never color alone.

2. Remove invented data and claims: replace all numeric source IDs, receipt IDs, fake counts, item totals, fake dates, advertiser/page names such as "Blockwise Homes", "Blockwise Realty", or "Blockwise Living", "2 receipts", "Showing 1-25 of 142 items", "all countries, all languages", and invented rule-set names. Use concise non-claim labels instead:
- source reference: "public observation reference"
- advertiser/page: "project-scoped advertiser"
- coverage: "configured project coverage"
- taxonomy: "project taxonomy revision"
- receipt list: "capture receipt", "classification receipt", "media QA receipt"
- receipt summary: "receipts retained"
- stream footer: "stream continues"
Keep "Blockwise real estate" only as the project context, not as an advertiser or customer claim.

3. Add a small neutral chip reading exactly "synthetic preview" beside the "Live creative stream" heading.

Keep these important labels correctly spelled and readable: "Frank", "Ad Radar", "Signal Desk", "Hermes owns execution", "discover", "resolve", "capture", "normalize", "classify", "media QA", "publish", "Run", "Pause", "Retry attention", "Approve publish", "Sources & brief", "Live creative stream", "Evidence inspector", "public source observation", "classification", "media QA", "provenance", "receipts", "quarantine", "approval required".

Constraints: change only the specified copy and accent colors; no new layout, no new pane, no second shell, no gradients, no glass, no tinted background, no invented names, identifiers, metrics, counts, dates, performance claims, or production status; no watermark.

provenance.method: Generated as a full-fidelity desktop UI comp, then edited once to remove invented values and non-brand red accents.
provenance.postprocess: Lanczos resize to 1440x900 and WebP encode at quality 96.
